text:
Sara (Support): AcroPay reporting intermittent 502/504s to hosted inference starting ~11:12 UTC. They see failures on both generate and streaming endpoints. Customer says it affects ~10% of requests and SDK retries are creating spikes. Attaching a minimal repro curl they used and a few request-ids they pasted.

Sara (Support): curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-x","input":"long system prompt ...","max_tokens":512}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

Sara (Support): Example IDs: rq_4f7a2, rq_4f7a9, rq_4f7b2 (timestamps match 11:12-11:24 UTC). Customer: "We also see repeated 502 then SDK retries -> 503/timeout loop."

StatusBot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-334 by Sara (Support) at 2026-05-08T11:18:43Z :eyes:

Ryan (Oncall): on it. Can you share full request headers and whether streaming=true? Also what SDK version?

Sara (Support): They say SDK v2.3.1, streaming=true for chat flows, and they set retryPolicy default. Quick header dump (sanitized):
```
:method: POST
:authority: api.redwood.example
:content-type: application/json
:authorization: Bearer <token redacted>
:user-agent: acropay-sdk/2.3.1
:content-length: 8192
```

Sara (Support): They also sent a short Node repro. See snippet: 
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.RW});
async function go(){
  const r = await client.generate({model:'gpt-x',input: longPrompt,stream:true});
  r.on('data',chunk=>{});
}
setInterval(go, 1000); // high QPS in their load test
```

Jordan (Eng): I pulled the gateway logs for rq_4f7a2/4f7a9/4f7b2. Pattern: upstream connection reset and then pool eviction. I'm seeing repeated "Broken pipe" in proxy when client aborts streaming early. Might be leak in connection state that trips concurrency limiter.

Maria (Infra): I'm seeing CPU spikes on gateway nodes in us-west-2 around the same window and many connections in "CLOSE_WAIT". Load balancer (alb-usw2-front) did a couple of 502s when backend worker count dipped. Temp mitigation: scaling the gateway ASG + increasing LB idle timeout from 30s -> 60s. Rolling restart on gateway group started.

Ryan (Oncall): Reproduced locally with a short client that starts a stream and closes early. With stream=true + default SDK retries, gateway sometimes returns 502 then client retries immediately -> we amplify pressure. Suggest instructing customer to set maxRetries=1 and increase backoff while we triage.

Sara (Support): Communicated to AcroPay: please set maxRetries=1 and disable aggressive retry in SDK for now, and we'll follow up with permanent fix. Customer ok to apply client-side change.

AcroPay (Customer): Thanks, doing that now. We'll confirm if errors drop. :pray:

Jordan (Eng): Found suspicious null check in proxy pool cleanup when streaming transport is aborted. If the client disconnects before handshake completes, we attempt to decrement active count twice -> negative concurrency metric -> rejection path returns 502. Created PR linking fix: https://internal/pull/5523 (WIP).

Jordan (Eng): Also adding defensive guard and better metric bounds. Running unit tests and a canary deploy to dev cluster.

Maria (Infra): Canary deploy to staging passed. I'll schedule 20% rollout to prod gateway nodes in us-west-2 and monitor CB errors and CLOSE_WAIT. Rolling now.

StatusBot: ROLLOUT STARTED PR-5523 -> gateway-usw2 (20%) at 2026-05-08T12:10:02Z

Ryan (Oncall): After disabling aggressive retries in customer test we saw error rate drop from ~9% -> 1.2% and latency stabilized. Good sign it's a retry amplification + connection cleanup bug.

Sara (Support): Customer confirms reduced errors after changing SDK setting. They want ETA for full fix and rollout.

Jordan (Eng): ETA: 2 hours to complete rollout and smoke checks. Will follow up when at 100%. Patch included in release notes: fix proxy pool double-decrement on aborted streams; add metric saturation guard; better logging for upstream resets.

Maria (Infra): Rollout to 100% complete at 2026-05-08T13:22:18Z. Observability: 502 count back to baseline, CLOSE_WAIT cleared, CPU normalized.

StatusBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED INC-2026-334 at 2026-05-08T13:30:05Z :white_check_mark:

Ryan (Oncall): Root cause summary for postmortem: 1) bug in gateway proxy pool cleanup when client aborts streaming causing negative concurrency and rejection path -> 502; 2) customer-side default SDK retry settings amplified transient failures into sustained load spikes; 3) LB idle timeout + gateway worker exhaustion contributed to 504s during spike.

Jordan (Eng): Action items: (a) ship PR-5523 (done), (b) add unit+stress test for early client disconnects (tracked in ENG-789), (c) add metric saturations guard to limiter config, (d) update release notes.

Ryan (Oncall): Customer comms: Sara, please send final note with timeline, recommended SDK rollback settings (maxRetries=1, backoff>=500ms), and apology.

Sara (Support): Sending now. Draft message: 
"Hi AcroPay — root cause was a gateway bug that could trigger 502s when clients abort streaming early. We deployed a fix and rolled it out at 13:22 UTC; your error rate should be back to normal. For short-term protection, we recommend setting SDK maxRetries=1 and using exponential backoff >=500ms. We're adding tests and extra guards so this doesn't recur. Sorry for the disruption — happy to jump on a call if you want."

AcroPay (Customer): Thanks, confirmed errors near zero for last 30m. Appreciate the quick fix and the mitigation guidance.

Jordan (Eng): I'll draft a short postmortem and link to logs + PR. Will include repro and test cases.

Ryan (Oncall): Closing the incident, tracking follow-ups in ENG-789 and SRE-402 for LB timeout review.

StatusBot: INCIDENT CLOSED INC-2026-334 at 2026-05-08T14:05:12Z
